column1: # The numbers a node holds (lib/lrc/FromWire.rsd "Numbers in nodes"). Where the place is read: one number taken for a list of them,
# and the first of a list taken for the list. Which classes keep the number: one that has an allocation of the wire's own form
# (the row numxnum of Images.tsv), one that has a read of it (numxlen). The place as the image wrote it, which every image takes when it is laid out as one class:
# the other type's function at an allocation and at a read, and the list of one number left empty. The programs that meet them:
# instruments/lrc-host/ProgNum.rsd, ProgNumInd.rsd, ProgNumX.rsd (rows num* of Images.tsv), ProgMap.rsd (mapat*).
# A node that is its number (`Lay.box`): the class's mark ignored, and a match that does not mark its class (the row numxtag of
# Images.tsv: instruments/lrc-host/ProgNumT.rsd); an allocation that takes another word for the number; a class that keeps the number
# in an object read as if the node were the number (numxtag again); a read that leaves its variable unbound.
# An integer's node holds the integer's one word (lib/lrc/FromWire.rsd "An integer is one word"): the two rows that named the sign's
# place in a node are gone with that place; the integer's word has its rows in MutantsMag.tsv.
# Not rows, and why. A read of a node's tag that is no match marks the class too (`primTagOf`): the front end writes a tag's read
# only as the test of a match, and no image with another was made. A read of a number's node as a list of children keeps the node an
# object (`Lay.box`, the list bit): no image has such a read. The guard after the read of a
# number's node is the guard `unpack` and `first` had; the read of the node before it has the same depth wherever the node is read
# where it stands, so no budget tells them apart. A place whose form is not seen (`numPackSite`, `numUnpackSite` answering 0) is
# written as the image wrote it and has the same value. The allocation's guard is a row of SidesMutants.tsv.
# The last row: the read of a list of numbers that is a function's whole body (lib/lrc/FromWire.rsd `trTail`) taken apart as a `let`
# again. The value is the same; the row numtail of Images.tsv (instruments/lrc-host/ProgNumTail.rsd) then allocates the cells of
# every list `unpack` builds, and instruments/lrc-host/Peaks.tsv has the direct form's number.
